services.name: Special Events
services.desc: Join us for one of Windsor's most coveted evening experiences! Our Special Event Cruises offer you and your guests an exhilarating and memorable night out. WPC provides Windsor's finest live bands & DJ's for entertainment. Setting the perfect atmosphere to dance the night away aboard the Macassa Bay. Soak in nightfall views of Detroit & Windsor shorelines under the twinkling stars. Marvel at the International bridges lit up at night to heighten your experience. Captain will cruise directly under both Ambassador & Gordie Howe Bridges. All passengers are required to be at least 19+ and have Special Event Party Cruise-19+

services.name: Ghost Ship Cruise
services.desc: 3 Hours About An early Halloween Cruise–Saturday, October 18 from 7-10pm. Boarding at 6PM. A Sunset cruise with a spooky flare. DJ Chino will be mixing the beats to make this Ghost Ship event spooktacular! Come dressed to enter the costume contest. Lucky 1st place winner will receive 2 Sunset passes-valued at $110. Runner up will receive 2 Sightseeing passes-values at $90. Drink specials & small plates available to purchase. Includes DJ onboard. Prizes for best costume: 1st Prize: 2 Sunset cruise tickets Runner-up: 2 Sightseeing passes More Info Boarding at 6pm No outside Ages 19+ • 3 Hours

services.name: Sightseeing Cruise of Detroit River (2hrs)
services.desc: Cruise 2hours Sightseeing cruises are the most affordable way for visitors and local residents to get out on the water for an enjoyable, afternoon scenic tour of the Detroit River. About Boarding 30 minutes prior to departure. Foot of Ouellette St, located behind Canadian flag. Relax and enjoy a view of historic Detroit River, including Hiram Walker, Belle Isle, waterfront mansions, and other notable locations on this Sightseeing Cruise. The lightly narrated tour shows you some of the region’s most unique and fascinating locations on the Detroit River waterfront! Enjoy a light lunch 2 Hours • All ages • Historic Cruise of Detroit River and history of the city of Windsor and Detroit

quotes.author: Dawn Beattie Hool
quotes.text: I had relatives visiting from B.C and we had a group of 7 of us for the 80’s night tour. We had the BEST time. Music was fun, the staff was amazing. We had drinks and ordered 2 charcuterie boards and other apps for our table which were great. My relatives throughly enjoyed the sites of both the Canadian and U.S sides and both bridges. It was a fantastic night. I plan on bringing my parents on an afternoon ride this summer. I highly recommend the tour.

quotes.author: Debbie Scott
quotes.text: What a great corporate event! For a second year in a row, Paul and Tammy and your crew killed it! All our staff really enjoyed the evening, the highlight was going to see the new bridge. It was a great evening, and I would highly recommend this for company events. The boat was beautifully decorated and very clean. Nothing out of place. Great job crew! Can't thank you enough. See you next year!

quotes.author: Satara Lamb
quotes.text: I took my husband on the 2 hour cruise to the Gordie Howe bridge for Father’s Day, and it was so nice! The views were amazing and it was so nice to see the City of Detroit from the river! There were places were had never seen before! We love new experiences and this cruise did not disappoint! Everyone was so nice, we will definitely do another cruise soon! ♥️

quotes.author: Gabriella Wickham
quotes.text: We hosted our wedding reception last summer on the Macassa Bay and it was just absolutely perfect. Our guests loved how unique this venue was and how beautiful of an experience it was. Staff were friendly and professional, and Tami and Paul were so accommodating in getting all details just right during planning and the evening-of. Thank you to all 💙

quotes.author: Sandy Tomlin
quotes.text: Went on the "Love Boat" Singles Cruise on Saturday Night with friends. We had an amazing time. The staff were fantastic, the views of both the Canadian and US side of the river were breathtaking. The DJ was playing great music to dance to. Totally worth the price for a great night out. Will definitely try to go on another Theme night for sure!

quotes.author: Larry Clark
quotes.text: My wife and I were in Windsor for the long weekend from London Ontario and we've seen the cruises before and decided to take one this time. Had a great experience learning the history of Windsor and Detroit. I would highly recommend it to anyone that has never cruised the Detroit river before. The crew was amazing.
